title: AirPads
description: This Adds Pads You Put On The Ground To Let You Go High In The Air.
body:
**[To Summon The Pads Use On Of The Trigger Commands When Holding A Nether Star]**
- **The Normal Air Pad Lets You Go 13 Blocks In The Air When Stepping On It**
- **The Gold Air Pad Lets Go Like 50 Blocks In The Air When Stepping On It**
- **The Fall Breaker Does What It Sounds Like, It Breaks Your Fall.**

**You Can Get Rid Of The Pads By Typing One Of The Trigger Command. Or Just Throw A Nether Star On Them. The Trigger Commands Only Work When Holding A Nether Star.**
- **Trigger Commands:**
- airpad_gold
- airpad_normal
- fallbreaker
- remove_pads
- remove_pads_1
